decisions.reason: Having survived its first review and fitting the firm's core lighting systems in a growing market, A appears to be at least near aspiration, so we keep it with only a low withdrawal risk.
C is a recent close-to-core launch with little performance history, but strategic fit and available slack justify keeping it while we learn whether it reaches aspiration.
D extends the firm's modular system logic for installers and planners, so we keep it because complementary products are usually given time unless clear underperformance emerges.
E also supports the established system offer but serves a somewhat narrower low-voltage niche, so we keep it while assigning a slightly higher withdrawal risk.
F matches the design-led portfolio but was marketed less prominently, indicating more uncertain market validation, so we keep it for now with the highest withdrawal probability in the set.
